input: Read /data/poem.txt and find the 3 most frequently used words. Print each word with its count, one per line, sorted by frequency descending.

transcript.final_response:
The three most frequent words in `/data/poem.txt` are:

```
the 8
on 3
cat 2
```

Several words are tied at 1 or 2 occurrences, so "cat" is third only because I broke the tie alphabetically. Only "the" and "on" are clear-cut. "Cat" appears twice, and no other word appears more than once.
tool_calls: tr -s '[:space:]' '\n' < /data/poem.txt | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | tr -d '[:punct:]' | grep -v '^$' | sort | uniq -c | sort -k1,1nr -k2 | head -3 | awk '{print $2, $1}'

tool_outputs.stdout:
the cat sat on the mat
the cat in the hat
the dog on the log
the frog on the bog
